en-US: Floe Agent 1.7.0 public beta (candidate build 241). Suggested checks: 1) Open Notes, import the bundled sample PDF or a backed-up document, annotate it, close and reopen it and confirm the edit persisted. 2) Search document text and open a search result. 3) Switch document tabs and collapse the editing header. 4) Configure your own cloud model provider (BYOK) and run a short multi-turn task: watch tool progress, stop execution and confirm the settings survive a relaunch. Cloud AI needs your own credentials and may incur third-party charges; no credits are provided. 5) If you download and test an MLX local model, it is Beta and not recommended for daily use: download size and memory depend on the model, and a text answer does not imply vision or every tool. Core Notes, documents and Canvas work without an AI provider. 6) If the frozen build includes the presentation repair, open a PowerPoint file, preview it, start the slideshow, change slides, exit back to editing and save, then report the exact behavior. Send feedback with device, OS, build number, reproduction steps and expected versus actual results, and redact keys and private content from screenshots.
zh-Hans: Floe Agent 1.7.0 公开测试版（候选构建 241）。建议测试：1）打开手记，导入随附示例 PDF 或可备份的文档，书写批注，关闭并重新打开，确认修改已保存。2）搜索文档正文并打开一条结果。3）切换文档标签，收起编辑页顶部抬头。4）配置你自己的云端模型服务（BYOK），执行一段多轮任务：观察工具进度、停止执行，并确认重启后设置仍然有效。云端 AI 需要你自己的凭据，可能产生第三方费用，我们不提供额度。5）如下载并测试 MLX 本地模型：该功能属于 Beta，暂不推荐日常使用；下载大小与内存占用取决于所选模型，文本回答不代表具备视觉或全部工具能力。手记、文档和画布的核心功能无需 AI 服务即可使用。6）如果冻结构建包含放映修复，请打开 PowerPoint 文件，预览、开始放映、换页、退出返回编辑并保存，然后报告实际表现。反馈请附设备、系统、构建号、复现步骤和预期／实际结果，截图前请遮去密钥与私人内容。
